instructions: Open the named approved project without changing camera, materials, geometry, lights, render engine, samples or color management.
Select the named scene and set frame 1. This is a single-frame native static asset; no action assignment is needed.
Set the ground root rotation Euler Z to the required direction angle; update the view layer. Keep root X/Y rotation zero, location [0,0,0], scale [1,1,1].

Render the named scene with its saved fixed camera at 384x704 RGBA. Use one rendering configuration for every direction. Replaying is a verification/reproduction action; promotion must copy the approved PNG bytes.
nativeStaticReplay.pythonExample:
scene = bpy.data.scenes['Crate wood warm soft round 02']
bpy.context.window.scene = scene
scene.frame_set(1)
root = bpy.data.objects['crate-wood__root']
root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, {'N': math.pi, 'E': math.pi/2, 'S': 0, 'W': -math.pi/2}[direction])
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
scene.render.filepath = output_png
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True, scene=scene.name)

notes: Editable native mesh parts share one registered ground root.
All four views are actual root rotations. No raster substitutes or per-view appearance changes.
